intro: The Mocha coffee table brings warmth and structure into your living space. With its walnut-toned veneer top and sturdy rubberwood base, it combines refined aesthetics with everyday durability.

features.title: Walnut rubberwood finish for timeless warmth
features.text: The Mocha coffee table’s MDF top is finished in patterned walnut veneer and is paired with a walnut-shaded rubberwood understructure. This cohesive tone enhances natural warmth while blending effortlessly into modern interiors.

features.title: Spacious tabletop for everyday functionality
features.text: With a generous surface, this coffee table offers ample room for décor, trays, books, and daily essentials. Moreover, its 18 mm thick top ensures sturdy performance.

features.title: Knockdown construction for easy handling
features.text: Designed in a knockdown format, this table is convenient to transport and assemble. This construction simplifies movement while maintaining structural integrity.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Mocha Engineered Wood Rectangular Coffee Table
